Item.Name: S_SPON_ID
Item.Hint: Enter a valid sponsor ID or few letters of name to search or select from LISTVAL.

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 count1 number ;
 x boolean ;
begin
 nullchk ; 
 check_package_failure ;
 select count(*) 
 into count1
 from sponsors S, rollover_preferences R
 where (S.sponsor_id = :control_block.s_spon_id or
 upper(name) like '%'||upper(:s_spon_id)||'%')
 and S.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id 
 and sysdate between S.eff_date and nvl(S.term_date,sysdate+1)
 and S.sponsor_id = R.sponsor_id 
 and S.chapter_id = R.chapter_id 
 and sysdate between R.eff_date and nvl(R.term_date,sysdate+1);
 if count1 = 0 then
 show_error('11142') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 elsif count1 = 1 then
 begin
 select name
 into :spon_name
 from sponsors S, rollover_preferences R
 where (S.sponsor_id = :control_block.s_spon_id or
 upper(name) like '%'||upper(:s_spon_id)||'%')
 and S.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id 
 and sysdate between S.eff_date and nvl(S.term_date,sysdate+1)
 and S.sponsor_id = R.sponsor_id 
 and S.chapter_id = R.chapter_id 
 and sysdate between R.eff_date and nvl(R.term_date,sysdate+1);
 -- do_retrieve_processing ;
 exception when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 elsif count1 > 1 then
 x := show_lov('SPON_LOV') ;
 end if ;
exception when others then 
 handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
end ;

ProgramUnit.Name: DECODE_STRING
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE decode_string IS
 temp_string varchar2(40) ;
 pos1 number ;
 pos2 number ;
 pos3 number ;
 pos4 number ;
 start_pos number;
 week_pref varchar2(10) ;
 inc_pos number ;
BEGIN
 if get_item_property(:system.trigger_item,ITEM_NAME) = 'JAN' then
 temp_string := :month_pref1 ;
 elsif get_item_property(:system.trigger_item,ITEM_NAME) = 'FEB' then
 temp_string := :month_pref2 ; 
 elsif get_item_property(:system.trigger_item,ITEM_NAME) = 'MAR' then
 temp_string := :month_pref3 ; 
 elsif get_item_property(:system.trigger_item,ITEM_NAME) = 'APR' then
 temp_string := :month_pref4 ; 
 elsif get_item_property(:system.trigger_item,ITEM_NAME) = 'MAY' then
 temp_string := :month_pref5 ; 
 elsif get_item_property(:system.trigger_item,ITEM_NAME) = 'JUN' then
 temp_string := :month_pref6 ; 
 elsif get_item_property(:system.trigger_item,ITEM_NAME) = 'JUL' then
 temp_string := :month_pref7 ; 
 elsif get_item_property(:system.trigger_item,ITEM_NAME) = 'AUG' then
 temp_string := :month_pref8 ; 
 elsif get_item_property(:system.trigger_item,ITEM_NAME) = 'SEP' then
 temp_string := :month_pref9 ; 
 elsif get_item_property(:system.trigger_item,ITEM_NAME) = 'OCT' then
 temp_string := :month_pref10; 
 elsif get_item_property(:system.trigger_item,ITEM_NAME) = 'NOV' then
 temp_string := :month_pref11 ; 
 elsif get_item_property(:system.trigger_item,ITEM_NAME) = 'DEC' then
 temp_string := :month_pref12; 
 end if;


if substr(temp_string,5,2) = 'WP' then
 start_pos := 8 ;
 for i in 1..7 loop
 inc_pos := instr(temp_string,':',start_pos,1) ;
-- message('INC_POS:'||to_char(inc_pos)) ; pause;
 week_pref := substr(temp_string,start_pos,inc_pos-start_pos) ;

 for j in 2..NVL(length(week_pref), 0) loop
 if i = 1 then
 if substr(week_pref,j,1) = '1' then :sun1 := 'Y' ;
 set_item_property('week_pref.sun1',Enabled, Property_True); 
 elsif substr(week_pref,j,1) = '2' then :sun2 := 'Y' ;
 set_item_property('week_pref.sun2',Enabled, Property_True); 
 elsif substr(week_pref,j,1) = '3' then :sun3 := 'Y' ;
 set_item_property('week_pref.sun3',Enabled, Property_True); 
 elsif substr(week_pref,j,1) = '4' then :sun4 := 'Y' ;
 set_item_property('week_pref.sun4',Enabled, Property_True); 
 elsif substr(week_pref,j,1) = 'L' then :sunl := 'Y' ;
 set_item_property('week_pref.sunl',Enabled, Property_True); 
 end if ;
 end if ; 
 if i = 2 then
 if substr(week_pref,j,1) = '1' then :mon1 := 'Y' ;
 set_item_property('week_pref.mon1',Enabled, Property_True); 
 elsif substr(week_pref,j,1) = '2' then :mon2 := 'Y' ;
 set_item_property('week_pref.mon2',Enabled, Property_True); 
 elsif substr(week_pref,j,1) = '3' then :mon3 := 'Y' ;
 set_item_property('week_pref.mon3',Enabled, Property_True); 
 elsif substr(week_pref,j,1) = '4' then :mon4 := 'Y' ;
 set_item_property('week_pref.mon4',Enabled, Property_True); 
 elsif substr(week_pref,j,1) = 'L' then :monl := 'Y' ;
 set_item_property('week_pref.monl',Enabled, Property_True); 
 end if ;
 end if ; 
 if i = 3 then
 if substr(week_pref,j,1) = '1' then :tue1 := 'Y' ;
 set_item_property('week_pref.tue1',Enabled, Property_True); 
 elsif substr(week_pref,j,1) = '2' then :tue2 := 'Y' ;
 set_item_property('week_pref.tue2',Enabled, Property_True); 
 elsif substr(week_pref,j,1) = '3' then :tue3 := 'Y' ;
 set_item_property('week_pref.tue3',Enabled, Property_True); 
 elsif substr(week_pref,j,1) = '4' then :tue4 := 'Y' ;
 set_item_property('week_pref.tue4',Enabled, Property_True); 
 elsif substr(week_pref,j,1) = 'L' then :tuel := 'Y' ;
 set_item_property('week_pref.tuel',Enabled, Property_True); 
 end if ;
 end if ; 
 if i = 4 then
 if substr(week_pref,j,1) = '1' then :wed1 := 'Y' ;
 set_item_property('week_pref.wed1',Enabled, Property_True); 
 elsif substr(week_pref,j,1) = '2' then :wed2 := 'Y' ;
 set_item_property('week_pref.wed2',Enabled, Property_True); 
 elsif substr(week_pref,j,1) = '3' then :wed3 := 'Y' ;
 set_item_property('week_pref.wed3',Enabled, Property_True); 
 elsif substr(week_pref,j,1) = '4' then :wed4 := 'Y' ;
 set_item_property('week_pref.wed4',Enabled, Property_True); 
 elsif substr(week_pref,j,1) = 'L' then :wedl := 'Y' ;
 set_item_property('week_pref.wedl',Enabled, Property_True);

 end if ; 
 if i = 5 then
 if substr(week_pref,j,1) = '1' then :thu1 := 'Y' ;

 if i = 6 then

 elsif substr(week_pref,j,1) = '2' then :fri2 := 'Y' ;

 elsif substr(week_pref,j,1) = '3' then :fri3 := 'Y' ;

 if i = 7 then

 elsif substr(week_pref,j,1) = '4' then :sat4 := 'Y' ;
 set_item_property('week_pref.sat4',Enabled, Property_True); 
 elsif substr(week_pref,j,1) = 'L' then :satl := 'Y' ;
 set_item_property('week_pref.satl',Enabled, Property_True); 
 end if ;
 end if ; 
 end loop ;
 start_pos := inc_pos + 1 ; 
 end loop ;
elsif substr(temp_string,5,2) = 'DR' then
 pos1 := instr(temp_string,':',6,1) ;
 pos2 := instr(temp_string,':',6,2) ; 
 pos3 := instr(temp_string,':',6,3) ; 
 pos4 := instr(temp_string,':',6,4) ; 
 :from_dy_month := to_number(substr(temp_string,pos1+1,pos2-pos1-1)) ;
 :to_dy_month := to_number(substr(temp_string,pos2+1,pos3-pos2-1)) ;
 for i in pos3+1..pos4-1 loop
 week_pref := substr(temp_string,i,1) ;
 if week_pref = '1' then :not_in_sun := 'Y' ;
 set_item_property('day_pref.not_in_sun',Enabled, Property_True); 
 elsif week_pref = '2' then :not_in_mon := 'Y' ;
 set_item_property('day_pref.not_in_mon',Enabled, Property_True); 
 elsif week_pref = '3' then :not_in_tue := 'Y' ;
 set_item_property('day_pref.not_in_tue',Enabled, Property_True); 
 elsif week_pref = '4' then :not_in_wed := 'Y' ;
 set_item_property('day_pref.not_in_wed',Enabled, Property_True); 
 elsif week_pref = '5' then :not_in_thu := 'Y' ;
 set_item_property('day_pref.not_in_thu',Enabled, Property_True); 
 elsif week_pref = '6' then :not_in_fri := 'Y' ;
 set_item_property('day_pref.not_in_fri',Enabled, Property_True); 
 elsif week_pref = '7' then :not_in_sat := 'Y' ;
 set_item_property('day_pref.not_in_sat',Enabled, Property_True); 
 end if ;
 end loop ;
end if ;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: TIME_FORMAT_FUNCTION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE time_format_function (input_str in varchar2,output_str out varchar2) IS
 string_length number ;
 formatted_str varchar2(5) ;
BEGIN
/*-- This procedure formats time in HH24:MI format ---*/ 

string_length := NVL(length(input_str), 0) ;

if string_length > 5 then
 show_error('11110') ;
 check_package_failure ;
elsif string_length = 5 then
 if substr(input_str,3,1) = ':' then

 if to_number(substr(input_str,1,2)) > 23 or to_number(substr(input_str,4,2)) > 59 then
 show_error('11110') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 else
 output_str := input_str ;
 end if ;
 else
 show_error('11110') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 end if ;
elsif string_length = 4 then
 output_str := substr(input_str,1,2) ||':'||substr(input_str,3,2) ;
 if to_number(substr(output_str,1,2)) > 23 or to_number(substr(output_str,4,2)) > 59 then
 show_error('11110') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 end if ;

else
 show_error('11110') ;
 check_package_failure ;
end if ;
exception
 when value_error then 
 show_error('11110') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 when others then
 handle_error ;
 check_package_failure ;
END;

-- Modified and verified for Y2K.....MG.....5/99
FUNCTION validate_day (day in number,month in varchar2) RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 month_char varchar2(2) ;
 last_day_of_month number;
BEGIN
 month_char := to_char(to_date('01-'||month||'-97','DD-MON-RR'),'MM') ;
 last_day_of_month := to_number(to_char(last_day(to_date('01'||month_char||'1997','DDMMYYYY')),'DD')) ;

 if day > last_day_of_month then
 return FALSE ;
 else
 return TRUE ;
 end if ;
 
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_format varchar2(100); 
begin
 if error_code = 40100 -- at first record
 then
 show_error('1700');
 elsif error_code = 40102 -- record must be entered first
 then
 show_error('1701');
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error('1702');
 elsif error_code = 41830 --list values contains no entries
 then
 show_error('12019');
 elsif error_code = 40201 -- field is full
 then
 show_error('1703');
 elsif error_code = 40202 -- field must be entered
 then
 show_error('0080');
 elsif error_code = 40207 -- must be in range
 then
 show_error('1704');
 elsif error_code = 40208 -- form in query mode, cant update
 then
 show_error('1705');
 elsif error_code = 41800 --list not available
 then
 show_error('1180');
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error('5050');
 elsif error_code in (40400,40406,40407)-- transaction committed
 then
 show_error('8010');
 elsif error_code = 40401 -- no changes to commit
 then
 show_error('8013');
 elsif error_code in (50002,50003,50004, -- invalid date
 50011,50012,50021,50023,50026)
 then
 temp_format := ltrim(GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:system.cursor_item,FORMAT_MASK),'FX');
 if upper(substr(temp_format,5,4)) = 'RRRR' then
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,1,4)||'YYYY';
 show_error('0022',temp_format );
 else
 if upper(substr(temp_format,5,2)) = 'RR' then
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,1,4)||'YY';
 show_error('0022',temp_format);
 else
 temp_format := ' ' ||temp_format;
 show_error('0022',temp_format);
 end if; 
 end if;
 elsif error_code in (50006,50007,50009, -- invalid number
 50013,50014,50015,50016,50020)
 then
 show_error('1707');
 elsif error_code in (50017,50018,50019,50022) -- invalid time
 then
 show_error('5016');
 elsif error_code in ('0','40209') -- invalid format
 then
 temp_format := ltrim(GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:system.cursor_item,FORMAT_MASK),'FX');
 if upper(substr(temp_format,5,4)) = 'RRRR' then
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,1,4)||'YYYY';
 show_error('0022',temp_format );
 else
 if upper(substr(temp_format,5,2)) = 'RR' then
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,1,4)||'YY';
 show_error('0022',temp_format);
 else
 temp_format := ' ' ||temp_format;
 show_error('0022',temp_format);
 end if; 
 end if;
 else
 message(substr(error_type||'-'||to_char (error_code)
 ||': '||error_text,1,80));
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
